scene_description: A classroom scene showing a female teacher standing at a green chalkboard with math problems written on it. Several children are seated at desks with their hands raised. The teacher appears to be calling on students.

questions.question: Who is standing at the board?
questions.sentence_frame: The ___ is standing at the board.
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the person standing in front of the chalkboard.

questions.question: What are the kids doing with their arms?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the children's arms and hands.

questions.question: Where is the teacher standing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is right behind the teacher.

questions.question: What is the chalkboard used for in school?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is written on the green board.

questions.question: The kids have their hands up — what do you think they want to do?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the teacher pointing and the kids with hands raised.

optional_extension_questions.question: Do you raise your hand at school?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about what you do in your classroom.
